sents.t: Rosa’s birthday was on October 15th.
She turned fifty!
Her son Danny and I planned a surprise party for her.
For two weeks, we kept it a secret.
Danny invited all her friends and family.
I made a big card, and everyone at the bookstore signed it.
Lily from Maple Café baked a chocolate cake with “Happy 50th Birthday, Rosa!” on it.
At three o’clock on her birthday, Danny took Rosa to the movies.
Then we decorated her apartment with balloons and flowers.
Twenty people came.
We waited in the dark living room.
At six o’clock, the door opened.
The lights went on, and we all shouted, “SURPRISE!”
Rosa put her hands on her face.
“Oh my goodness!” she said.
She laughed, and then she cried a little.
We sang “Happy Birthday,” and Rosa blew out the candles.
She opened her presents: a new coat, a book about Italy, and a photo album.
I gave her a painting of Max.
Emma painted it!
“This is the best birthday of my life,” Rosa said.

comp.q: How many people came to the party?
